name: Injoku Miko Oyako ~Kindan no Majiwari~
original_name: 淫辱巫女母娘～禁断の交わり～
source:
Main character Yuji is constantly pressed to inherit Shinto shrine by his mother and sister. He has a special ability to talk to the tree in this shrine. One day, in response to Yuji's desire for power, plant gets into boy's body and grants him ability to use tentacles...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公白山优司不断遭到母亲和妹妹催促，要他继承家中神社。他拥有一种特殊能力，可以与神社里的树木交谈。某天，植物回应优司对力量的渴望，钻进少年体内，赋予他操纵触手的能力……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vndb-of-month-may-2007-draculius.html]vndbreview[/url]]
